headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Callahan's Passage and Island Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Callahan's Passage has erupted into renewed turmoil after an earlier lull in base movement, logging eight strategic base transitions and nearly two thousand casualties over the past two hours around The Crumbling Passage and Scáth Passing. Fisherman's Row continues to witness intense island fighting, recording ten base exchanges in the two-hour window as positions shifted at Eidolo and Black Well. Weathered Expanse remains the central maelstrom of the war, racking up nine fresh base events and more than twenty-three hundred casualties in two hours across Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Along the western approaches, Nevish Line registered two base shifts at Grief Mother amid heavy attrition exceeding twenty-one hundred casualties in two hours. By contrast, territorial flips stalled in Mooring County and Stlican Shelf despite continued severe casualty rates, while Palantine Berm settled into quiet. Secondary island skirmishes flared at Stema Landing with four base actions, while the southern mainland regions remain dormant.
